style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A narrow grounded blue stone barrier with substantial softly lit rounded/faceted native masses, readable lower body and seamless true repeated ports in every facing.

priorityOutcomes.desired: Several readable large rounded/faceted stone masses should give this narrow straight blue barrier convincing depth. Use a controlled silhouette and purposeful broad form breaks within the finite functional strip. Improve the weak flat slab construction without turning the narrow barrier into a broad shelf or inventing another terrain role.
priorityOutcomes.verification: All four registered facings at published2x, logical1x and phone scene scale, plus native and independently composed repeats. A view with little new contour can still succeed through useful volume, surface curvature and material separation.

priorityOutcomes.desired: Keep cobalt/blue stone with cyan upper planes, distinct readable midtones and sparse deeper blue recesses. Broad soft highlights should explain rounded planes without a preferred horizontal key. The bottom must retain readable blue volume instead of a nearly black horizontal dead band. Restrained creases and a few purposeful small stone details may enrich the form, while avoiding white glare, uniformly outlined rocks, microtexture, glow or unrelated decorations.
priorityOutcomes.verification: Compare target/original/candidate on neutral light, gray and dark grounds at matched full-canvas registration. Inspect the cap faces and narrow E/W views as well as the broad N/S faces. No foreground-intensity rule is borrowed from another object; this is opaque blocking world terrain.

priorityOutcomes.desired: No clipping, coplanar flicker, black pits, muddy merged masses, floating base, exposed internal cut, abrupt normal break or new seam stripe. Repeat modules must form a coherent continuous blue stone barrier with the exact finite port section, both natively and after independent published-sprite composition. Native cut material/normal transitions may be redesigned to achieve this; the old cap/top color discontinuity is not a lock.
priorityOutcomes.verification: Four native and independent W/E-axis repeats, close seam crops and phone/common-canvas browser screenshots in both required headless modes. Diagnose finite geometry, alpha coverage and opaque RGB discontinuities separately.

Same-profile translation and proper all4 rotations; cap geometric winding/outward normals oppose. No source profile transplant from rock-wall/shelf, mirror or growth/rounded join cuts.

Full finite ground strip X[-.5,.5]/Y[-.17,.17]/Z0/area.34; complete geometry sameXY/Z[0,.95], 1e-5 float representation tolerance. Original body facets/partcounts/interior height variation/dark ramp are not locks. No fullsquare widening, overhang, floating base or new holes below opaque blocking terrain.
